findings.summary: Legends Plot accepts are silently dropped: `color: { legend: "swatches" | "ramp" }` and legends on symbol/opacity/r draw nothing, because the code sets every color legend off and passes `figure: false`, which makes real Plot (0.6.19) skip appending legends. The tests use a stand-in for Plot so they cannot see how real Plot handles `figure: false`.
